candidate.title: Added support for honouring Destination Rule Certificates for MESH_EXTERNAL services instead of Metadata certificates
candidate.text: Added support for honouring Destination Rule Certificates for MESH_EXTERNAL services instead of Metadata certificates. This can be reverted by setting PREFER_DESTINATIONRULE_TLS_FOR_EXTERNAL_SERVICES to `false`.

evidence.excerpt:
- |
  **Added** support for honouring Destination Rule Certificates for MESH_EXTERNAL services instead of Metadata certificates.
  This can be reverted by setting PREFER_DESTINATIONRULE_TLS_FOR_EXTERNAL_SERVICES to `false`.
